mentions.name: muy
mentions.description: A web-based animation tool that replaces keyframe and tween setup with real-time recording: select a layer, manipulate its properties, and the timeline captures every frame. It runs in the browser with no install or account required, described as Excalidraw for animation.
mentions.problem: Animation tools require setting keyframes and tweens instead of letting users perform animations in real time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been building this little animation tool I’ve wanted for years, inspired by one of Bret Victor’s demos from his talk “Inventing on Principle”. I wrote about it here [1].

Basically, instead of setting keyframes and tweens, you perform animations in real time: select a layer, manipulate its properties and the timeline records every frame.

No install, no account needed. It's like Excalidraw, for animation.
